paper_title: Bounding the Treewidth of Outer k-Planar Graphs via Triangulations
statement: We have introduced methods for triangulating drawings of outer k-planar graphs such that the triangulation edges cross few graph edges. These triangulations yield better bounds on treewidth and separation number of outer k-planar graphs. Our method is constructive; the corresponding treewidth decomposition and balanced separation can be computed efficiently. Via our triangulations, we improved the multiplicative constant in the upper bound on the treewidth of outer k-planar graphs from 3 to 1.5; we showed a lower bound of 1. What is the correct multiplicative constant? Finding triangulations of outer k-planar graphs with lower triangle piercing number could be a step in this direction. It would also be interesting to find other graph classes that admit triangulations with low triangle piercing number.
